description: Link a record through a relation field to target records (by uuid or public number). Default ADDS links; `replace: true` sets the link set to exactly `targets`, which is how a one-to-many link is re-pointed or cleared (adding a second target without replace returns a 409). Target ids come from search / query_records.

relation_field.description: The relation field on this database (api_name, name, or id).

replace.description: Replace the whole link set with `targets` instead of adding to it — required to change a one-to-many link (#81).

targets.description: Target record uuids or public numbers. With replace:true, an empty array clears all links.

name: link_records
title: Link records
